name: ux_novice_step
purpose: ux_critic's text-only novice, used when the vision model is unavailable: how likely a first-time user is to press one control next, given only the goal and the control's visible label. The novice samples controls in proportion to it.

fields.name: goal
fields.meaning: What the user wants to get done, in plain words as the app's ux spec states it, followed by the controls already pressed toward it this run, if any.

fields.name: control
fields.meaning: The visible label of one control on the current screen, or (no label) when it shows none.

ask.instructions: Would a first-time user press `control` as the next step toward `goal`?
ask.yes: the label in `control` names `goal` itself, or the place in the app where `goal` is done
ask.no: the label in `control` is unrelated to `goal`, or `control` shows no label

gate.why: never a gate: a sampling weight for the text-only novice. Measured 2026-09-28 on the ux fixtures (calibration/ux-2026-09-28-kev-*.json): it separated a buried mode (9 vs 5 of 12 runs) and a 5-deep action (2 vs 0 of 3) but not unlabelled icons (15 vs 13 of 21) or scattering (1 vs 1 of 3), and failed good-variant primary tasks 2 of 3 times, so its novice failures never fail a task
